en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street in a historic European town. On the left stands a tall, ornate multi‑story building with decorative gables and a pointed turret roof. The ground floor has a shopfront with display windows and hanging garments, while several pedestrians walk or stand nearby. On the right, part of a large stone structure with an archway frames the view; under the arch a couple of figures stand looking toward a river or lower street beyond. The image is printed on the upper portion of the card with a blank area for writing below.
